title: PROVISIONAL wire schema — MCP revision 2026-07-28 — PHASE 1 SUBSET ONLY — v0/v1alpha1
x-status: PROVISIONAL — NOT RATIFIED — DO NOT TREAT AS A CONFORMANCE ORACLE
x-stability: v1alpha1 — may change incompatibly without notice
x-conformance-claim: NONE. This file makes no claim about what the Model Context Protocol does or does not define. mcpmock emulates requirements.md plus an authored annex.
x-WARNING: READ THIS BEFORE USING THIS FILE AS AN ORACLE.
This schema was AUTHORED by the mcpmock specification process. It was NOT derived from a
published MCP specification document, because no such document for revision 2026-07-28 was
available to the authors. Its shapes come from requirements.md (labelled [R]), from logical
derivation (labelled [D]), and — for 21 of the constructs below — from PROPOSALS invented to
fill gaps an implementer could not proceed past (labelled [P-nn] in x-label fields).
Validating against this schema proves ONE thing: that mcpmock is self-consistent with its own
annex. It proves NOTHING about interoperability with any real MCP client or server.
Every [P-nn] construct is subject to change when GAP-003 is ratified. On ratification, this
file and the prose annex change together, golden fixtures are regenerated, and — per ADR-019 —
handler code does not change, because wire shapes are data.
SCOPE: this file covers the PHASE 1 SUBSET ONLY: the _meta envelope, server/discover,
tools/list and tools/call. Mirrored headers, -32020/21/22, pagination, SSE framing, MRTR,
subscriptions and every legacy era are OUT OF SCOPE and will be added in Phase 2+.

x-usage.selfCheck: switches.selfCheck=true validates every outgoing Phase 1 result against #/$defs/phase1Result before it is written. MOCK-201.4.
x-usage.goldenFixtures: TASK-027 golden fixtures assert against the specific $def for the method under test.
x-usage.testClient: test/mcpclient (ADR-017) validates responses it receives against this file, independently of server code.

jsonRpcId.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 id. Null ids are not emitted by mcpmock. Raw lexical form is preserved on echo (TASK-009).

metaEnvelope.title: _meta envelope
metaEnvelope.description: Carried at params._meta. Annex 2.5 [P-06] — the LOCATION is proposed and is the single most consequential choice in this file: it changes every request the hub builds.

clientCapabilities.description: REQUIRED under validateMeta=strict. Map of capability name to capability object.

progressToken.description: Phase 2 (MOCK-210). Accepted and journalled in Phase 1, never acted on.

metaEnvelope.x-additionalProperties-rationale: Annex 2.11 [D]: unknown _meta keys are ignored and PRESERVED in the journal (MOCK-601, MOCK-203.6). additionalProperties MUST stay true — tightening it would make the schema reject conformant-but-extended requests.

serverInfo.description: Present in _meta on EVERY result unless switches.omitServerInfoMeta.

resultType.description: PHASE 1 SUBSET of annex 4.2 [P-21]. The full enum has 11 values; the other 8 belong to methods that do not exist in Phase 1 and are added in Phase 2+.

cacheHints.description: Result-level cache hints on server/discover and list methods.
cacheHints.x-label: [R MOCK-201, MOCK-232] presence; [P-23] cacheScope value set

cacheScope.description: Proposed set is public|private, but MOCK-232.4 requires ARBITRARY strings be emittable, so this is deliberately not an enum.

textContentBlock.description: The ONLY content block Phase 1 emits (builtin-tools.md 1.2 [P-40]).

discoverResult.title: server/discover result
discoverResult.description: MOCK-201.3: an OMITTED field is ABSENT, never present-and-null. That is why nothing here is required except resultType — each field is independently omissible by configuration, and the schema must accept every omission combination.

extensions.description: Extension URI/name to arbitrary JSON. MOCK-201.2 variation is Phase 2.

toolDescriptor.description: A tools/list entry. MOCK-222.3 and MOCK-224.3: inputSchema, outputSchema, annotations and icons are emitted VERBATIM and are DELIBERATELY NOT VALIDATED — the whole point is that mcpmock can serve a hostile or malformed schema. They are therefore `true` (accept anything) here, and that is intentional, not an oversight.

toolListResult.title: tools/list result
toolListResult.description: Phase 1 is UNPAGINATED: nextCursor is not emitted. Pagination is MOCK-231, Phase 2, and will add nextCursor here.

toolCallResult.title: tools/call result
toolCallResult.description: builtin-tools.md 1.2. isError is emitted ONLY when true (builtin-tools.md 4.2 [P-50]) — hence `const: true`, which makes an accidental "isError": false a schema violation rather than a silent inconsistency.

phase1Result.description: SELF-CHECK ENTRY POINT. switches.selfCheck validates every outgoing Phase 1 result against this. MOCK-201.4.

errorObject.title: JSON-RPC error object
errorObject.description: Phase 1 emits -32700, -32600, -32601, -32602, -32603. The MCP-specific -32020/-32021/-32022 are Phase 2. The code is deliberately an unconstrained integer, not an enum: MOCK-505 (Phase 9) requires arbitrary and retired codes to be emittable, and builtin-tools.md 4.3 makes `fail` the Phase 1 seam for that.

phase1Response.title: Phase 1 JSON-RPC response
phase1Response.description: Exactly one of result or error, per JSON-RPC 2.0 section 5.
